wiki.title: Bronzeknuckles
wiki.text:
Bronzeknuckles is a dwarf enemy NPC that players fight in the Rumbledome, located in Sunstone Valley. He is a Skullz rumbledome gladiator whose allegiance is with the Skullz. The Rumbledome announcer states that prior to the battle, Bronzeknuckles had been at Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse.
